parsed.rationale: Both `HandleINIntent` and `SiriIntentDonated` are `type-alias-object` declarations in the same file (`Shared/Analytics/Sources/Analytics/Events/IntentEvents.swift`) within the `Analytics` package, separated by only 10 lines (lines 16 and 26). Although the structural signal reports `shared_field_count: 1` and flags them as exact duplicates in shape, they carry distinct names encoding distinct domain events — one represents handling an INIntent, the other represents donating a Siri intent. These are semantically different analytics events whose structural coincidence (both are empty-field type aliases) is incidental to the event-taxonomy design, not evidence of unintended duplication. No restraint markers are present, but merging or extracting them would collapse two intentionally separate event concepts into one, harming domain clarity.
